dogecoin.text:
The family is now up 22x+ on their #Dogecoin since January (see below). I’m glad I didn’t buy them #Bitcoin!

No more frumpy stares! I’m getting ❤️ 24/7. They say they’re going to #HODL. https://t.co/IzHiErQgXF

Crypto flashback to this week in 2014.

Fun fact: #Dogecoin was actually the #5 crypto by market cap then and it was just back to being #5 today. And yes, the values have changed.

#Bitcoin market cap was $5bn then, and $1.2 trillion today. #Dogecoin was $27m then, $50bn today. https://t.co/YJ3ZK00Esu

If @elonmusk owned Twitter, I’m pretty sure he would make #Dogecoin its official payment currency. Clearly, if people could hold $DOGE in their Twitter account and pay with it, $TWTR stock would go up.

@jack why can’t we?
